question: Should Discord Activities be accepted through a Canvas-plugin-owned Activity bridge, and if so what fail-closed auth/token model should replace this draft's root `canvasHost.activity` query-token design?
rationale: The patch adds a new public Gateway access path, command/action surface, and config contract; choosing the permanent auth model and plugin boundary is a maintainer security/product decision, not a mechanical rebase.

options.title: Redesign on plugin seams
options.body: Port the work to current Discord and Canvas plugin paths, require explicit credentials or launch context, avoid URL-carried secrets, and keep the Gateway bounded before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Adopt the successor PR after repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65205 as the landing branch only after it is clean, proof-positive, and addresses the same security and compatibility blockers.

options.title: Pause Activities in core
options.body: Keep Discord Activities out of core until maintainers decide the plugin API and security contract are ready.

recommendation.title: Redesign on plugin seams
recommendation.body: Port the work to current Discord and Canvas plugin paths, require explicit credentials or launch context, avoid URL-carried secrets, and keep the Gateway bounded before reconsidering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the draft and the related modern-path Discord Activities PR, so they are the best first owner for the direction choice with Canvas/Gateway review.
